narrative: Material PL3__M8E7DBB2 exhibits a highly_variable demand pattern with a mean of 296.8 units/day (CV=0.54) and a significant upward trend detected over the observation window (March 2025 – March 2026). Lead times average 0.75 working days with a CV of 0.96, classified as highly_variable, driven by several spike events reaching 4.3 days. A continuous-review (r,Q) policy with reorder point 700 and order quantity 722 is recommended, yielding estimated annual inventory costs of $8,437 compared to $8,893 under the current SAP baseline.
warnings: Statistically significant demand trend detected. EOQ assumes stationary demand — monitor and revise quarterly.

research_insights.selection_rationale: The highly_variable demand pattern (CV=0.54) and highly_variable lead times make a continuous-review (r,Q) policy the most appropriate choice. It provides a clear reorder trigger at 700 units and a fixed EOQ-based order quantity of 722 units, balancing ordering and holding costs while respecting the MOQ of 34 and storage cap of 2818 units.
